dataset.description_md: Dungeness crab (Metacarcinus magister) megalopae and larval decapods picked from archived CalCOFI oblique-tow plankton samples, examined for the California Department of Fish and Wildlife. Two efforts: a 2008-2014 time series of 310 sorted samples (A. Klemmedson, 2015) yielding 24 M. magister megalopae from 14 samples, and 216 archived samples from the 1949-2009 sorting log that were examined and found free of M. magister (1984-2009, E. Jones, as of 2012-02-15). Only examined samples are published — the log's remaining unsorted rows are a fact of the archive's inventory, not a sample of this dataset. Spring cruises, CalBOBL oblique tows, lines < 80 / stations < 90. Counts are occurrence in the examined aliquot, not standardized density. Sorting was performed at the SIO Pelagic Invertebrate Collection, where the removed megalopae are archived in vials.

status.blockers: IN THE RELEASE since 2026-08-14 (CC BY 4.0, Q01 answered). 2026-09-03: cut over to EXAMINED SAMPLES ONLY — the core now publishes 526 events (310 sorted time-series subsamples + 216 examined sorting-log tows), down from 2,321; the 1,795 unsorted log rows are dropped from the core entirely (an unexamined archived jar is a fact of the deposit's sorting-log inventory, not a sample of this dataset) and no longer ship as effort-only sample rows. Emits the consolidated core (sample 526 / obs 1456 / obs_attribute 24 / sample_measurement 617 / taxon 17 / dataset_taxon 3) via the generic append_* helpers in-notebook. Coverage now measures 1984-05-17 to 2014-05-03 (was 1949-2014 including unsorted effort). 3 xlsx sources -> 310 examined samples 2008-2014 (24 M. magister megalopae, 15 removal vials / 14 samples) + 216 examined-and-empty sorting-log tows 1984-2009 + 5 verification specimens; station match 306/310 via swfsc_ichthyo. link_data_source is a placeholder UCSD Library RDC search URL pending the deposit's DOI (Q14, new). Q05 open: new sample_type=subsample + cross-dataset parent_sample_key. Q08 (positive-longitude sign error) affects only a dropped unsorted row; deposit README reportedly corrects it — reconcile once the deposit zips are in Drive (Ben, before 2026-09-26).
status.publish_policy: Archive of record: UC San Diego Library Digital Collections deposit (CDFW's data, sorted at SIO). EDI does not apply; OBIS planned (Darwin Core Archive of the 24 megalopae occurrences built and staged each release; the upload is CDFW's call).
